profile.headline: Senior Principal Data Engineer | Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
profile.summary:
I’m a data engineering and analytics leader with extensive experience building scalable, cloud-based data platforms that deliver real business results. I’ve boosted sales by 10%, reduced reporting cycle times by 97%, and streamlined inventory and supply chain operations.

I’ve designed and managed high-volume clickstream data workflows that improved marketing campaign conversion rates by 15% through smarter audience targeting. I’ve led and developed high-performing teams, delivered predictive models that improved ETA accuracy by 25%, and launched secure data-sharing platforms that generate more than $5 million in annual revenue—empowering real-time, data-driven decision-making across the organization.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Snowflake · Python (Programming Language) · SQL · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Warehousing

positions.title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
positions.description:
•	Architected cloud-based data platforms that contributed to a 10% increase in sales and unlocked new analytics capabilities across the enterprise.
•	Built and led high-performing teams of up to 13 engineers, fostering technical excellence and accelerating skill growth.
•	Cut reporting cycle time by approximately 97% (reducing from monthly to daily), thereby enabling near real-time decision-making and swifter business response.
•	Enhanced pipeline forecast accuracy by 18% by implementing advanced analytics models and rigorous data quality controls.
•	Developed data pipeline for predictive models that increased ETA accuracy by 25%, significantly mitigating supply chain delays.
•	Designed and deployed real-time Power BI dashboards adopted across five depots, supporting proactive inventory management.
•	Reduced replenishment lead time by 15%, preventing costly stockouts and excess inventory.
•	Collaborated with sales, marketing, and inventory stakeholders to deliver scalable analytics solutions aligned with business objectives.

positions.title: Data Engineering Lead
positions.description:
•	Engineered data workflows to process high-volume clickstream data, resulting in a 15% increase in marketing campaign conversion rates through enhanced audience targeting.
•	Established a secure data sharing platform that generates over $5 million annually in licensing revenue from external partners. 
•	Automated data quality assurance procedures, reducing manual quality assurance hours by 40%.
•	Implemented partition automation, resulting in a 30% decrease in processing time.
•	Developed Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and profiling tools that reduced data onboarding time by 25%.
•	Created the "Nomad" tool, which minimized cross-environment migration time from three days to less than eight hours.
•	Built and maintained comprehensive end-to-end Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) pipelines, integrating third-party and internal data sources to facilitate real-time operational insights.
•	Mentored over twelve engineers, leading to two promotions to the technical lead role.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led consolidating and migrating 1000+ DataStage jobs from multiple servers and legacy versions to DataStage v11 as part of an insourcing initiative, enhancing maintainability and performance.
•	Reverse-engineered numerous undocumented ETL interfaces to produce comprehensive technical design documents, facilitating precise redevelopment and future maintainability.
•	Designed and developed ETL pipelines in DataStage to integrate data from various heterogeneous sources into target systems, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant at Computer Information System Department
positions.description:
•	Conducted research on Computer Information Systems programs and emerging topics to facilitate curriculum development.
•	Provided instruction and guidance to a classroom of over 30 undergraduate students, enhancing their understanding and engagement
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Excel · Teaching · Microsoft PowerPoint

company.name: Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Led requirements analysis and data-driven market segmentation for a Health IT database project.
•	Designed, implemented, tested, and maintained the system, ensuring reliable performance.
•	Engaged with Health IT companies to collect and validate critical data.
•	Managed and mentored undergraduate team members, fostering collaboration and skill development.
positions.insights: Skills: Team Leadership · SQL · Microsoft Access · Stakeholder Engagement

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented an ETL pipeline to transfer data from Excel and API sources into a major telecom client's Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) repository. This enabled the SOA Governance Team (SGT) to fulfill 100% of the Design-Time Governance (DTG) requirements throughout the entire SOA service lifecycle. Delivered a centralized, single source of truth for SOA-related information, increasing data accuracy by 20% and decreasing effort for dependent applications by 30%.
•	Led the design and delivery of logistics-focused Business Intelligence (BI) cubes utilizing Hyperion Performance Suite, reducing report generation time from several days to minutes and facilitating real-time decision-making.
•	Developed dimensions, facts, and a comprehensive Data Dictionary, standardizing analytics procedures across various departments and enhancing data accuracy by 15%.
•	Provided comprehensive end-to-end support for DataStage, Hyperion, and Oracle servers, maintaining a system uptime of 99% and addressing critical issues within the stipulated Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
•	Conducted training sessions for departmental users on BI tools, which resulted in a 40% increase in self-service analytics adoption and diminished dependence on Information Technology (IT) for reporting tasks.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Led the design and development of a centralized Middleware & Messaging portal, integrating security, content management, RBAC, workflow, and reporting into a single interface.
•	Developed database structures and delivered XML-based front-end modules using XSL under stringent deadlines, earning client commendation.
•	Enhanced PL/SQL code for reporting modules, resulting in a 30% improvement in application performance.
•	Provided technical leadership, conducted code reviews, and mentored new team members to ensure quality delivery and expedited onboarding

projects.title: SOA Repository
projects.description: This project aims to deliver a SOA Repository solution for O2 UK. This solution will enable the SOA Governance Team (SGT) to address all Design-Time Governance (DTG) requirements across the entire SOA service lifecycle, which entails the inception, design, development, build, testing and operation of SOA services typically delivered by the O2 Service Factory. This solution also provides a single source for SOA related information for other integrated applications.

projects.title: BERS SOA Migration
projects.description:
BERS solution was built in order to minimize the costs involved in responding to the large number of calls made by CUK based Post-Pay customers to Customer Services requesting their bundle balance (unused balance of minutes, text, data and recent charges) on their contract.
BERS solution has been successfully running ever since it was launched. 
This initiative was to enrich the current BERS solution to support Multi-MSISDN based billing enquiries while removing the WAP based functionality (as it is being addressed by WP4) in order to eliminate functional redundancy across solutions and migrate the current BERS solution to SOA platform and orchestrate the SOA services.
